messages:
sam: Heads up team 1: small but noisy import tagged 2.1k accounts as 'needs-onboard' and our auto-playbook fired. Seeing support tickets. Can someone halt outbound touches?

infra-bot: playbook-runner: run id pb-20260324-77 started 2026-03-24T09:02:03Z, recipients: 2104, phase: sending.

anya: Pausing now (Admin -> Playbooks -> needs-onboard -> Pause). Also toggled worker drain.

pete: Quick triage: 2,104 recipients; 74 renewals within 30d, 18 high-risk. Most are legacy duplicates from partner mapping issue.

margo: Proposal: suppress cohort, run owner-claim dry-run on 250, auto-claim exact email matches only, and send apology only to trials. Also add playbook preflight: if cohort_size > 1000 OR renewals_pct > 1% then require manager approval.

sam: Agreed. Can we also add an immediate safety change: default new playbooks to dry_run=true unless explicitly opt-in?

anya: yes will push a config patch: `playbook_template: { "dry_run": true, "cohort_threshold": 1000 }` and add checkbox in Admin UI. Will post PR link.

pete: Running dry-run: `python cs_tools/claim_owners.py --cohort partner-y-20260323 --limit 250 --dry-run`

infra-bot: playbook-runner: pb-20260324-77 paused by anya at 2026-03-24T09:12:15Z. recipients_sent: 1,028.

sam: Thanks. Quick 10-min call to confirm handoffs and copy for apology. Keep outreach embargoed for cohort until backfill + suppressions done.

margo: I'll draft the apology and a one-question survey. Sam, I'll DM the copy for sign-off.

pete: Dry-run results: 1,020 exact owner matches, 420 fuzzy. Auto-claiming exacts now with rate=150/min, rest to manual queue.

sam: Nice. Please include this incident in the postmortem: cause = partner mapping, missed preflight, and mitigations (dry-run default, cohort size gate, renewals exclusion).

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/cs-playbooks/pull/1423 (adds dry_run default and cohort_threshold).

sam: Great work everyone. Will follow up with retro invite. :thumbsup:
